words.enDefinition: an arranged time to see a dental professional

examples.en: I booked a dental appointment for Friday because my last lecture ends at noon.
examples.zh: 我把「牙科预约」约在周五，因为那天最后一节课中午就结束了。

examples.en: The receptionist called to confirm my dental appointment at the clinic near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近的诊所前台打电话确认了我的「牙科预约」。

words.enDefinition: a place where a dentist sees and treats patients

examples.en: I called the dental office to ask how long the first appointment would take.
examples.zh: 我给「牙科诊所」打电话，问初诊大概需要多久。

examples.en: The dental office is upstairs, across the hall from the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 「牙科诊所」在楼上，隔着走廊和校园书店相对。

words.enDefinition: a business or organization that provides dentistry services

examples.en: My roommate found a dental practice that was still accepting new patients.
examples.zh: 我室友找到一家还在接收新患者的「牙科诊疗机构」。

examples.en: The dental practice offered me an appointment on a day without lectures.
examples.zh: 这家「牙科诊疗机构」给我安排了一个没课的日子就诊。

words.enDefinition: a staff member who handles calls and appointments for a dentist

examples.en: The dental receptionist helped me find an appointment between my two afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 「牙科前台接待员」帮我在下午两节课之间找到了一个就诊时段。

examples.en: I told the dental receptionist that my phone number had changed since last term.
examples.zh: 我告诉「牙科前台接待员」，上学期之后我的手机号换了。

collocations: a dental receptionist at the front desk

words.enDefinition: a dental professional who provides cleaning and preventive oral care

examples.en: The dental hygienist asked me which areas were difficult to reach when brushing.
examples.zh: 「口腔卫生师」问我刷牙时哪些地方不好刷到。

examples.en: I scheduled time with the dental hygienist on the same day as my checkup.
examples.zh: 我把见「口腔卫生师」的时间安排在我做检查的同一天。

collocations: a visit with the dental hygienist

words.enDefinition: a worker who supports the dentist during patient care

examples.en: The dental assistant showed me where to put my backpack before I sat down.
examples.zh: 我坐下前，「牙科助理」告诉我背包可以放在哪里。

examples.en: I asked the dental assistant whether there was somewhere to leave my coat.
examples.zh: 我问「牙科助理」有没有地方放外套。

words.enDefinition: a specialist in correcting tooth alignment and bite problems

examples.en: The dentist suggested an appointment with an orthodontist to discuss my uneven bite.
examples.zh: 牙医建议我去见「口腔正畸医生」，问问我咬合不齐的情况。

examples.en: I asked the orthodontist to write down the names of the devices we discussed.
examples.zh: 我请「口腔正畸医生」写下我们谈过的那些矫治器的名称。

words.enDefinition: a dentist specializing in the tissues inside teeth and root canals

examples.en: My dentist gave me the contact details for an endodontist near the station.
examples.zh: 牙医给了我一位在车站附近执业的「牙髓专科医生」的联系方式。

examples.en: The endodontist looked at the images the clinic had sent before my appointment.
examples.zh: 「牙髓专科医生」在我就诊前看了诊所发来的影像。

words.enDefinition: a dentist specializing in gums and tissues supporting teeth

examples.en: I asked what records the periodontist needed from my previous dental office.
examples.zh: 我问「牙周专科医生」需要我原来的牙科诊所提供哪些记录。

examples.en: The periodontist explained the numbers written beside each tooth on my chart.
examples.zh: 「牙周专科医生」解释了牙位图上每颗牙旁边写的数字。

words.enDefinition: a dental specialist who restores teeth or replaces missing teeth

examples.en: The clinic booked me with a prosthodontist to discuss replacing a missing tooth.
examples.zh: 诊所帮我约了一位「口腔修复专科医生」，讨论缺牙修复。

examples.en: I brought my old treatment summary to the appointment with the prosthodontist.
examples.zh: 我去见「口腔修复专科医生」时，带了以前的治疗摘要。

words.enDefinition: a specialist who performs surgery involving the mouth and jaws

examples.en: I checked whether the oral surgeon had received the panoramic image from my dentist.
examples.zh: 我确认了「口腔外科医生」有没有收到我的牙医发去的全景片。

examples.en: The clinic gave me the oral surgeon's office number and asked me to bring identification.
examples.zh: 诊所给我「口腔外科医生」的办公室电话，并请我带上证件。

collocations: a referral to an oral surgeon

words.enDefinition: a dentist trained to provide oral care for children

examples.en: My sister asked whether a pediatric dentist was available at the university clinic.
examples.zh: 我姐姐问大学的诊所有没有「儿童牙科医生」。

examples.en: The pediatric dentist explained the names of the teeth to my niece before the examination.
examples.zh: 检查前，「儿童牙科医生」给我外甥女讲了几种牙齿的名称。

collocations: a visit to a pediatric dentist

words.enDefinition: a request to another provider for dental assessment or care

examples.en: I received a dental referral after the dentist reviewed the images with me.
examples.zh: 牙医和我一起看了影像后，我收到了「牙科转诊」。

examples.en: The specialist's office asked when the dental referral had been sent to them.
examples.zh: 专科诊所问这份「牙科转诊」是什么时候发给他们的。

words.enDefinition: a regular visit to assess the health of teeth and gums

examples.en: My routine dental checkup happened to fall on the same day as my seminar.
examples.zh: 我的「常规牙科检查」恰好和研讨课在同一天。

examples.en: I asked whether the routine dental checkup fee included any pictures of my teeth.
examples.zh: 我问「常规牙科检查」的费用是否包含牙齿拍片。

words.enDefinition: a visit arranged promptly for a serious dental problem

examples.en: I asked whether an emergency dental appointment was available after I broke a tooth.
examples.zh: 牙齿摔断后，我问有没有「牙科急诊预约」的空位。

examples.en: The receptionist called with an emergency dental appointment while I was waiting outside the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆门外等的时候，前台打电话说帮我约到了「牙科急诊」。

words.enDefinition: a form collecting information before a patient's first dental visit

examples.en: I completed the dental intake form on my phone before the first visit.
examples.zh: 第一次就诊前，我在手机上填了「牙科初诊登记表」。

examples.en: The dental intake form asked for the date of my last visit to a dentist.
examples.zh: 「牙科初诊登记表」问我上一次看牙医是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: a record of previous oral problems and dental care

examples.en: The dentist asked about my dental history because I had studied abroad last year.
examples.zh: 我去年在国外读书，牙医问了问我的「牙科就诊史」。

examples.en: I brought a short summary of my dental history from my old clinic.
examples.zh: 我带了一份旧诊所出具的简短「牙科就诊史」摘要。

words.enDefinition: a diagram or record showing findings for individual teeth

examples.en: The receptionist checked whether my dental chart had arrived from the previous practice.
examples.zh: 前台查了我原来那家机构有没有发来「牙科检查记录图」。

examples.en: The dentist marked a small chip on my dental chart during the exam.
examples.zh: 检查时，牙医在我的「牙科检查记录图」上标了一处小崩缺。

collocations: mark a finding on the dental chart

words.enDefinition: pain that is felt in or around a tooth

examples.en: I described my toothache and pointed to the side where I felt it.
examples.zh: 我描述了「牙痛」，还指出了疼的是哪一边。

examples.en: My roommate had a toothache and called the clinic after our tutorial.
examples.zh: 我室友「牙痛」，辅导课结束后给诊所打了电话。

words.enDefinition: tooth discomfort triggered by stimuli such as cold or touch

examples.en: I mentioned tooth sensitivity when the dentist asked what brought me to the clinic.
examples.zh: 牙医问我为什么来诊所时，我提到了「牙齿敏感」。

examples.en: The form asked whether tooth sensitivity happened with cold drinks or at other times.
examples.zh: 表格问我，「牙齿敏感」是在喝凉饮料时发作，还是也会在其他时候出现。

words.enDefinition: pain felt when the teeth press together during a bite

examples.en: I told the dentist about pain on biting and showed her which side hurt.
examples.zh: 我告诉牙医我「咬合时疼痛」，并指出了疼的是哪边。

examples.en: The intake form asked if I had noticed pain on biting during meals.
examples.zh: 初诊登记表问我，吃饭时有没有出现过「咬合时疼痛」。

words.enDefinition: gums that have become enlarged or puffy

examples.en: The dentist asked when I first saw swollen gums beside the back tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医问我，最早是什么时候发现后牙旁边有「牙龈肿胀」。

examples.en: My friend mentioned swollen gums when the receptionist asked why she wanted an appointment.
examples.zh: 前台问我朋友为什么要约就诊时，她提到了「牙龈肿胀」。

words.enDefinition: gums from which blood comes during brushing or at other times

examples.en: I noted bleeding gums on the form because the question was about oral symptoms.
examples.zh: 表格问到了口腔症状，我就在上面注明了「牙龈出血」。

examples.en: The hygienist asked how often I had noticed bleeding gums since my last appointment.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师问我，从上次就诊后多久会碰到一次「牙龈出血」。

words.enDefinition: gum tissue pulling back and exposing more of a tooth

examples.en: I asked the dentist to show me what receding gums looked like on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我请牙医在图上给我看看「牙龈退缩」是什么样子。

examples.en: The report mentioned receding gums near two of the teeth on my left side.
examples.zh: 报告提到，我左边有两颗牙附近发生了「牙龈退缩」。

words.enDefinition: a tooth that moves more than it normally should

examples.en: I pointed to the loose tooth when the dentist asked where the movement was.
examples.zh: 牙医问我哪里会动，我就指了指那颗「松动的牙齿」。

examples.en: The clinic asked when I had first noticed the loose tooth at home.
examples.zh: 诊所问我在家最早是什么时候发现这颗「松动的牙齿」的。

words.enDefinition: a tooth with a small piece broken off

examples.en: I told the clinic about the chipped tooth after noticing a rough edge.
examples.zh: 发现牙边上有一处粗糙后，我向诊所说明了「崩缺的牙齿」的情况。

examples.en: The dentist took a photograph of the chipped tooth before we discussed the report.
examples.zh: 我们谈报告前，牙医给那颗「崩缺的牙齿」拍了照。

words.enDefinition: a tooth with a split but possibly no missing piece

examples.en: The chart mentioned a cracked tooth near the back of my lower jaw.
examples.zh: 检查记录提到，我下颌靠后有一颗「有裂纹的牙齿」。

examples.en: I asked the dentist whether the cracked tooth appeared on the image we reviewed.
examples.zh: 我问牙医，我们刚看的片子上能不能看到那颗「有裂纹的牙齿」。

words.enDefinition: a tooth that is absent from its usual position

examples.en: The dentist marked my missing tooth on a diagram before discussing the available options.
examples.zh: 牙医先在图上标出我那颗「缺失的牙齿」，再和我讨论有哪些选择。

examples.en: The photograph clearly showed the space left by the missing tooth on the right.
examples.zh: 照片清楚地显示了右侧那颗「缺失的牙齿」留下的空隙。

collocations: the position of a missing tooth

words.enDefinition: a filling that has come out of the tooth

examples.en: The dentist asked when I first noticed the lost filling on the back tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医问我最早是什么时候发现后牙上「补牙材料脱落」的。

examples.en: I described the lost filling to the receptionist while booking my visit that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上预约就诊时，我向前台说明了「补牙材料脱落」的情况。

collocations: a tooth with a lost filling

words.enDefinition: a pocket of pus caused by infection in dental tissues

examples.en: I asked what dental abscess meant after reading that term in my dentist's report.
examples.zh: 我在牙医报告里看到「牙源性脓肿」这个词，就问它是什么意思。

examples.en: The dentist noted a suspected dental abscess and explained why another examination was needed.
examples.zh: 牙医记录了疑似「牙源性脓肿」，并解释了为什么还需要再检查。

words.enDefinition: a clicking sound when the jaw is moved

examples.en: I mentioned jaw clicking when the dentist asked about sounds near my jaw.
examples.zh: 牙医问我下颌周围有没有响声，我提到了「下颌弹响」。

examples.en: The form asked whether jaw clicking occurred when eating or at other times.
examples.zh: 表格问到「下颌弹响」是在吃饭时出现，还是在其他时候也有。

words.enDefinition: rubbing the upper and lower teeth against each other

examples.en: The dentist asked whether anyone had noticed teeth grinding while I was asleep.
examples.zh: 牙医问我睡觉时有没有人注意到我「磨牙」。

examples.en: I wrote down the term teeth grinding after my dentist mentioned it during the checkup.
examples.zh: 牙医在检查时提到了「磨牙」，我把这个词记了下来。

words.enDefinition: pressing the upper and lower teeth firmly together

examples.en: I mentioned tooth clenching after the dentist asked what happened when I was studying.
examples.zh: 牙医问我学习时有什么情况，我提到了「紧咬牙关」。

examples.en: The leaflet explained how tooth clenching differed from grinding the teeth at night.
examples.zh: 说明书解释了「紧咬牙关」和夜间磨牙有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a dental appliance worn during sleep to protect teeth

examples.en: The dentist asked me to bring my night guard to my next appointment.
examples.zh: 牙医请我下次就诊时带上自己的「夜间护牙套」。

examples.en: I left the night guard in its case before packing my overnight bag.
examples.zh: 收拾过夜包之前，我把「夜间护牙套」放回了盒子。

words.enDefinition: a front tooth with a thin edge for cutting food

examples.en: The diagram showed which incisor the dentist had checked during the visit.
examples.zh: 图上标出了牙医就诊时检查的是哪颗「切牙」。

examples.en: I asked why the left incisor was shaded on the printed diagram.
examples.zh: 我问打印出来的图上，为什么左边那颗「切牙」涂了颜色。

words.enDefinition: a pointed tooth between the incisors and the premolars

examples.en: The dentist pointed to my canine tooth while explaining the position shown on screen.
examples.zh: 牙医指着我的「尖牙」，说明屏幕上标的是哪个位置。

examples.en: I could see the tip of the canine tooth clearly in the photograph.
examples.zh: 我在照片上能清楚看见那颗「尖牙」的尖端。

words.enDefinition: a tooth positioned between a canine and the back molars

examples.en: My dentist marked the second premolar on the left side of the chart.
examples.zh: 牙医在图上标出了左侧第二颗「前磨牙」。

examples.en: The premolar was easier to identify once she showed me the diagram.
examples.zh: 她把图给我看之后，那颗「前磨牙」就容易辨认多了。

words.enDefinition: a broad back tooth used to crush and grind food

examples.en: The dentist asked me to point to the molar on the bottom row.
examples.zh: 牙医让我指出下面一排的那颗「后槽牙」。

examples.en: I referred to the molar when asking a question about my old image.
examples.zh: 我拿着之前的片子提问时，说的是那颗「后槽牙」。

words.enDefinition: one of the third molars at the back of the mouth

examples.en: I asked the dentist to locate my wisdom tooth on the screen during the visit.
examples.zh: 就诊时，我请牙医在屏幕上指给我看「智齿」的位置。

examples.en: The report mentioned a wisdom tooth near the back of the lower jaw.
examples.zh: 报告提到，下颌最里面有一颗「智齿」。

words.enDefinition: one of the first teeth that develop in childhood

examples.en: My niece showed the dentist her loose baby tooth before sitting in the chair.
examples.zh: 我外甥女坐到牙椅上之前，给牙医看了她那颗松动的「乳牙」。

examples.en: The dentist used a picture of a baby tooth to explain my nephew's chart.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张「乳牙」的图片，给我外甥讲他的检查记录图。

words.enDefinition: a tooth belonging to the adult set of teeth

examples.en: The dentist explained why this permanent tooth was marked in a different color.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，为什么这颗「恒牙」用了不同的颜色标记。

examples.en: I asked whether the image showed a permanent tooth below the one on top.
examples.zh: 我问那张片子上，上面那颗牙下方显示的是不是一颗「恒牙」。

words.enDefinition: the bony structure that holds the upper row of teeth

examples.en: The dentist pointed to the upper jaw on the model before checking my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医先在模型上指了指「上颌」，才检查我的牙齿。

examples.en: I asked for a copy of the image showing my left upper jaw.
examples.zh: 我索要了一份显示左侧「上颌」的影像副本。

collocations: an image of the upper jaw
the left side of the upper jaw

words.enDefinition: the movable bone supporting the lower row of teeth

examples.en: The specialist used a drawing of the lower jaw to explain the report.
examples.zh: 专科医生用一张「下颌」的图给我解释报告。

examples.en: I showed the dentist which side of my lower jaw felt different while eating.
examples.zh: 我给牙医指出，吃饭时「下颌」的哪一侧感觉不一样。

collocations: an image of the lower jaw
the front of the lower jaw

words.enDefinition: the boundary where the gums meet the teeth

examples.en: The hygienist pointed to an area near the gumline on my chart.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师在检查记录图上指了指「龈缘」附近的一处。

examples.en: I asked what the small marks along the gumline meant in the photograph.
examples.zh: 我问照片上沿着「龈缘」的那些小印记是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the hard outer layer covering the exposed part of a tooth

examples.en: The dentist used a diagram to show where tooth enamel covers the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张图说明「牙釉质」覆盖牙齿的哪些部位。

examples.en: I asked what the note about tooth enamel meant before putting the report away.
examples.zh: 收起报告前，我问了关于「牙釉质」的那条备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: hard tissue beneath enamel or cementum that surrounds the pulp

examples.en: The diagram showed dentin between the enamel and the central soft tissue.
examples.zh: 图上显示，「牙本质」在牙釉质与中央的软组织之间。

examples.en: The dentist pointed to the word dentin in the handout during our discussion.
examples.zh: 讨论时，牙医指了指资料上的「牙本质」一词。

words.enDefinition: soft tissue inside a tooth containing nerves and blood vessels

examples.en: The specialist used a picture to show where the tooth pulp sits.
examples.zh: 专科医生用一张图指出了「牙髓」的位置。

examples.en: I wrote down tooth pulp after the dentist named the soft tissue layer.
examples.zh: 牙医说出那层软组织的名称后，我把「牙髓」记了下来。

collocations: an image of the tooth pulp

words.enDefinition: the part of a tooth embedded beneath the gum

examples.en: The dentist pointed to the tooth root on the image before explaining her findings.
examples.zh: 牙医先在影像上指了指「牙根」，再解释她看到了什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the photograph showed the entire tooth root or just its tip.
examples.zh: 我问那张图上显示的是整个「牙根」，还是只有根尖。

collocations: the tip of a tooth root
an image of the tooth root

words.enDefinition: the soft tissue surrounding teeth along the jaw

examples.en: The dentist used a model to show how gum tissue surrounds each tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医用模型展示了「牙龈组织」怎样包围每颗牙。

examples.en: I asked what the note about gum tissue meant in my examination summary.
examples.zh: 我问检查摘要里关于「牙龈组织」的备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: an examination that looks for possible signs of oral cancer

examples.en: I asked whether oral cancer screening was covered during the checkup at this clinic.
examples.zh: 我问这家诊所做检查时，是否包括「口腔癌筛查」。

examples.en: The dentist explained how oral cancer screening was recorded on the examination form.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了「口腔癌筛查」在检查表上是怎么记录的。

words.enDefinition: an assessment of how the upper and lower teeth meet

examples.en: The dentist added a bite check to my appointment after I mentioned discomfort when chewing.
examples.zh: 我提到咀嚼时不舒服，牙医就给这次就诊加了一项「咬合检查」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bite check was listed separately on my appointment summary.
examples.zh: 我问就诊摘要上是不是单独列了「咬合检查」。

words.enDefinition: an image showing the crowns of nearby upper and lower teeth

examples.en: The dentist opened my bitewing X-ray on screen so we could discuss the findings.
examples.zh: 牙医在屏幕上打开了我的「咬翼片」，方便我们讨论检查发现。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic could email my bitewing X-ray to the new practice.
examples.zh: 我问诊所能不能把我的「咬翼片」发邮件给新诊所。

words.enDefinition: a wide dental image showing both jaws and their teeth

examples.en: The specialist asked whether I already had a panoramic X-ray from my regular dentist.
examples.zh: 专科医生问，我常去的牙医那儿有没有现成的「牙科全景片」。

examples.en: I requested a copy of the panoramic X-ray before transferring to the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 转到校园诊所之前，我申请了一份「牙科全景片」副本。

words.enDefinition: a dental image showing a tooth and its root area

examples.en: The dentist compared the new periapical X-ray with one from my previous visit.
examples.zh: 牙医把新的「根尖片」和我上次就诊时拍的那张作了比较。

examples.en: I asked which periapical X-ray belonged to the tooth mentioned in the report.
examples.zh: 我问哪一张「根尖片」对应报告里提到的那颗牙。

words.enDefinition: a negative mold of the teeth and nearby oral structures

examples.en: The receptionist told me how long the dental impression appointment was likely to last.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，做「牙齿印模」的预约预计会花多久。

examples.en: I asked whether the new clinic could use my previous dental impression for reference.
examples.zh: 我问新诊所能不能参考我以前做的「牙齿印模」。

collocations: send a dental impression to the lab

words.enDefinition: a digital three-dimensional recording of teeth and nearby tissues

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me the intraoral scan on a tablet after the appointment.
examples.zh: 就诊结束后，正畸医生用平板给我看了「口内扫描」结果。

examples.en: I asked if the clinic could send my intraoral scan to another practice.
examples.zh: 我问诊所能不能把我的「口内扫描」发给另一家诊所。

words.enDefinition: a system for identifying individual teeth with numbers or symbols

examples.en: I asked which tooth numbering system the practice used on the printed diagram.
examples.zh: 我问诊所打印出来的图使用的是哪种「牙位编号」系统。

examples.en: The dentist explained why the tooth numbering differed from that on my old records.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，为什么「牙位编号」和旧记录上的编号不同。

words.enDefinition: a concentrated fluoride coating applied to teeth by a professional

examples.en: I asked what the words fluoride varnish meant on the clinic's service list.
examples.zh: 我问诊所服务清单上的「氟化物涂膜」是什么意思。

examples.en: The staff highlighted fluoride varnish as a separate item on my appointment record.
examples.zh: 工作人员在我的就诊记录上，把「氟化物涂膜」单独标了出来。

words.enDefinition: professional cleaning to remove deposits from the teeth

examples.en: I booked a dental cleaning at the university clinic after my afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 下午的研讨课结束后，我在大学诊所约了「牙齿专业清洁」。

examples.en: The receptionist checked how much time was set aside for the dental cleaning.
examples.zh: 前台查看了给「牙齿专业清洁」预留了多长时间。

collocations: the cost of a dental cleaning

words.enDefinition: professional removal of deposits from the surfaces of teeth

examples.en: I asked the hygienist where dental scaling was listed on the written estimate.
examples.zh: 我问口腔卫生师，书面估价单上「洁牙刮治」列在哪里。

examples.en: The clinic's price list showed dental scaling under its gum care services.
examples.zh: 诊所价目表把「洁牙刮治」列在了牙龈护理服务下面。

words.enDefinition: professional cleaning and smoothing of tooth root surfaces

examples.en: I asked the specialist to explain root planing when it appeared on my plan.
examples.zh: 「根面平整」出现在我治疗方案上时，我请专科医生解释了一下。

examples.en: The receptionist showed me where root planing was listed on the appointment summary.
examples.zh: 前台给我指了就诊摘要上列出「根面平整」的位置。

words.enDefinition: a deepened space between the gum and the tooth

examples.en: The dentist explained what a gum pocket looked like on the diagram.
examples.zh: 牙医在图上讲解了「牙周袋」是什么样子。

examples.en: I noticed a number beside each gum pocket in the specialist's report.
examples.zh: 我注意到专科报告里每个「牙周袋」旁边都有一个数字。

words.enDefinition: distance from the gum margin to the bottom of a pocket

examples.en: I asked which numbers indicated gum pocket depth on the chart from my visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次就诊的检查记录图上，哪些数字表示「牙周袋深度」。

examples.en: The specialist compared gum pocket depth values from my recent and previous visits.
examples.zh: 专科医生比较了我最近和以往就诊时的「牙周袋深度」数值。

words.enDefinition: bleeding noted when a dentist gently examines the gum with a probe

examples.en: The dentist explained what bleeding on probing meant in the notes from my examination.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了我的检查记录里「探诊出血」是什么意思。

examples.en: The chart recorded bleeding on probing at several sites around the back teeth.
examples.zh: 检查记录图记载，后牙周围好几个位置有「探诊出血」。

words.enDefinition: an accumulation of a sticky bacterial film on teeth

examples.en: The hygienist showed me where plaque buildup was visible in the photograph.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师在照片上给我指出了能看到「牙菌斑堆积」的位置。

examples.en: The dental chart recorded plaque buildup on the inside surfaces of several teeth.
examples.zh: 牙科检查记录上写明，有几颗牙的内侧出现了「牙菌斑堆积」。

words.enDefinition: an accumulation of hardened deposits formed from dental plaque

examples.en: The hygienist used a model to explain where tartar buildup was commonly seen.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师用模型解释了哪些地方常见「牙结石堆积」。

examples.en: I asked how tartar buildup was recorded in the notes from my dental visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次看牙的记录是怎么注明「牙结石堆积」的。

words.enDefinition: inflammation of gum tissue without loss of tooth support

examples.en: I asked what gingivitis meant after reading the note beneath my dental photographs.
examples.zh: 我在牙齿照片下面看到一条备注，就问其中的「牙龈炎」是什么意思。

examples.en: The dentist showed me where gingivitis appeared in the examination summary on screen.
examples.zh: 牙医在屏幕上给我指出了检查摘要里提到「牙龈炎」的位置。

words.enDefinition: gum disease that damages the tissues supporting the teeth

examples.en: The specialist explained periodontitis after comparing the measurements recorded during my last two visits.
examples.zh: 专科医生对照我最近两次就诊时测量的数据后，解释了什么是「牙周炎」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the report were relevant to the discussion of periodontitis.
examples.zh: 我问报告中哪些部分和刚才谈的「牙周炎」有关。

words.enDefinition: gradual breakdown of tooth structure in the process of caries

examples.en: The dentist showed me where she was checking for tooth decay in the photographs.
examples.zh: 牙医在照片上指给我看，她在哪个位置排查「龋坏」。

examples.en: I asked whether the line about tooth decay referred to a particular tooth.
examples.zh: 我问提到「龋坏」的那一行是不是指某颗特定的牙齿。

words.enDefinition: a hole in a tooth caused by decay

examples.en: I asked whether the cavity shown on the screen was from my latest image.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的「龋洞」是不是出现在我最近拍的那张片子上。

examples.en: The dentist explained which surface of the tooth had the cavity.
examples.zh: 牙医说明了「龋洞」在这颗牙的哪一面。

words.enDefinition: material placed in a tooth to restore a damaged area

examples.en: The dentist checked the dental filling on my back tooth during the examination.
examples.zh: 牙医在检查时查看了我后牙上的「补牙填充体」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the bill covered the dental filling on the left side.
examples.zh: 我问账单上哪个项目对应左侧的「补牙填充体」。

words.enDefinition: a usually tooth-colored restoration made of composite resin

examples.en: The estimate listed a composite filling and included a short description of the material.
examples.zh: 估价单列了「复合树脂补牙填充体」，并简单介绍了这种材料。

examples.en: I asked the dentist to point out the old composite filling in my photograph.
examples.zh: 我请牙医在我的照片上指出原来的「复合树脂补牙填充体」。

collocations: an estimate for a composite filling

words.enDefinition: a short-term restoration placed in a prepared tooth

examples.en: My dentist noted a temporary filling on the report from my previous visit.
examples.zh: 牙医在我上次就诊的报告里注明了「临时补牙填充体」。

examples.en: I asked whether the temporary filling was listed separately on my account statement.
examples.zh: 我问账单上是否单独列出了「临时补牙填充体」。

collocations: a tooth with a temporary filling

words.enDefinition: a fitted cap covering a prepared tooth or supported by an implant

examples.en: The dentist used a model to explain where the dental crown sits.
examples.zh: 牙医用模型给我说明了「牙冠修复体」戴在哪个位置。

examples.en: The dental crown was mentioned in an estimate I brought from my former clinic.
examples.zh: 我从原来诊所带来的估价单上提到了「牙冠修复体」。

words.enDefinition: a short-term cap protecting a prepared tooth before the final restoration

examples.en: The dentist showed me the temporary crown before adding it to my treatment record.
examples.zh: 牙医把「临时牙冠」给我看了看，然后记入我的治疗记录。

examples.en: I asked why the estimate showed a temporary crown and a permanent one separately.
examples.zh: 我问估价单为什么把「临时牙冠」和永久牙冠分开列。

collocations: a temporary crown on a back tooth

words.enDefinition: a fixed restoration that replaces one or more missing teeth

examples.en: The specialist showed me a model with a dental bridge in place.
examples.zh: 专科医生给我看了一个装有「牙桥」的模型。

examples.en: I asked which terms in the estimate referred to the dental bridge we discussed.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上哪些术语指的是我们谈到的「牙桥」。

collocations: an estimate for a dental bridge

words.enDefinition: a fixture in the jawbone that supports a replacement tooth

examples.en: I asked which part of the diagram represented the dental implant in the jaw.
examples.zh: 我问图中哪一部分表示颌骨里的「牙种植体」。

examples.en: The report listed the crown and dental implant as separate items on the plan.
examples.zh: 报告把牙冠和「牙种植体」作为方案里的两个项目分开列出。

collocations: a dental implant in the upper jaw
an estimate for a dental implant

words.enDefinition: a removable appliance replacing some but not all teeth in an arch

examples.en: My aunt asked whether the clinic could adjust her partial denture during the visit.
examples.zh: 我姨妈问这次就诊时，诊所能不能调整她的「局部义齿」。

examples.en: The dentist used a model to describe where the partial denture would sit.
examples.zh: 牙医用模型讲解了「局部义齿」佩戴的位置。

collocations: a partial denture for the lower jaw

words.enDefinition: removable artificial teeth replacing all natural teeth in a jaw

examples.en: The teaching clinic had a model showing how full dentures fit over the gums.
examples.zh: 教学诊所有个模型，展示「全口义齿」如何贴合牙龈。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimate for full dentures included any follow-up visits at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「全口义齿」的估价是否包含诊所的复诊费用。

words.enDefinition: a fitted restoration that sits within a tooth without covering its cusps

examples.en: The dentist used a diagram to show how an inlay fits inside the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张图展示了「牙科嵌体」如何嵌在牙齿里。

examples.en: I asked whether inlay meant the same thing as filling on this estimate.
examples.zh: 我问这份估价单上的「牙科嵌体」和补牙填充体是不是同一种东西。

words.enDefinition: a fitted restoration covering at least one tooth cusp

examples.en: The dentist drew an outline to show where the onlay covers the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医画了个轮廓，说明「牙科高嵌体」覆盖牙齿哪里。

examples.en: I asked whether the onlay on my estimate was shown on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我问图上有没有画出估价单上写的「牙科高嵌体」。

words.enDefinition: a thin layer bonded to the front of a tooth

examples.en: The dentist showed me the difference between a dental veneer and a crown.
examples.zh: 牙医给我展示了「牙贴面」和牙冠修复体的区别。

examples.en: I asked which tooth the dental veneer referred to on the written estimate.
examples.zh: 我问书面估价单里的「牙贴面」指的是哪颗牙。

collocations: a consultation about a dental veneer

words.enDefinition: a coating placed in tooth grooves to protect those surfaces

examples.en: The dentist showed us where the dental sealant was recorded on the child's chart.
examples.zh: 牙医给我们指出了孩子检查记录图上注明「窝沟封闭剂」的位置。

examples.en: I asked which line of the estimate referred to the dental sealant on the molar.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上哪一行对应磨牙上的「窝沟封闭剂」。

collocations: a dental sealant on a molar

words.enDefinition: a procedure treating the inside of a tooth and its canals

examples.en: The dentist explained why root canal treatment was mentioned in the notes sent to the specialist.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，为什么发给专科医生的记录里提到了「根管治疗」。

examples.en: I asked for an estimate for root canal treatment before checking my insurance benefits.
examples.zh: 查看保险保障前，我先索要了一份「根管治疗」的估价单。

collocations: book a root canal treatment appointment
a referral for root canal treatment

words.enDefinition: the removal of a tooth by a dental professional

examples.en: I asked the clinic whether the tooth extraction fee was on the printed plan.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，打印出来的方案上有没有列「拔牙」的费用。

examples.en: The dentist explained which tooth the tooth extraction would involve in my case.
examples.zh: 牙医解释了，我的情况涉及对哪颗牙进行「拔牙」。

words.enDefinition: removal of a tooth without a surgical approach to expose it

examples.en: The estimate listed a simple extraction separately from the cost of taking images.
examples.zh: 估价单把「简单拔牙」和拍片的费用分开列。

examples.en: I asked what the clinic meant by a simple extraction on the written plan.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，书面方案上所说的「简单拔牙」是什么意思。

collocations: a quote for a simple extraction

words.enDefinition: removal of a tooth using a surgical approach

examples.en: The dentist wrote surgical extraction on the referral and explained which tooth it concerned.
examples.zh: 牙医在转诊单上写了「手术拔牙」，并说明涉及的是哪颗牙。

examples.en: I asked whether the fee for surgical extraction was shown on a separate page.
examples.zh: 我问「手术拔牙」的费用是不是列在另一页。

words.enDefinition: the extraction of one or more backmost permanent molars

examples.en: I asked how the specialist would record wisdom tooth removal on the treatment estimate.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生，治疗估价单上会怎么注明「拔除智齿」。

examples.en: The clinic called about my wisdom tooth removal consultation while I was walking to campus.
examples.zh: 我去学校的路上，诊所打电话和我确认了「拔除智齿」的咨询预约。

collocations: a consultation about wisdom tooth removal
an estimate for wisdom tooth removal

words.enDefinition: a document or outline describing proposed dental care

examples.en: I took home the dental treatment plan so I could read it after class.
examples.zh: 我把「牙科治疗方案」带回去，打算下课后再看。

examples.en: The dentist highlighted the sections of the dental treatment plan that we had discussed.
examples.zh: 牙医在「牙科治疗方案」上标出了我们已经谈过的几部分。

collocations: a copy of the dental treatment plan

words.enDefinition: practices and conditions related to keeping the mouth clean

examples.en: The hygienist asked about oral hygiene and noted my answers on the form.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师问了我「口腔卫生」方面的问题，并把回答记在了表上。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic had an oral hygiene leaflet in my first language.
examples.zh: 我问诊所有没有用我母语写的「口腔卫生」说明单。

words.enDefinition: toothpaste containing a fluoride compound as an ingredient

examples.en: The hygienist pointed to the section on fluoride toothpaste in the printed handout.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师指了指纸质资料上介绍「含氟牙膏」的一节。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where the fluoride toothpaste label listed the ingredients.
examples.zh: 我问药师，「含氟牙膏」的标签上哪个位置列了成分。

words.enDefinition: a small brush shaped to fit between adjacent teeth

examples.en: The hygienist showed me an interdental brush on a model of the teeth.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师用一个牙齿模型给我看了「牙缝刷」。

examples.en: I asked which symbol on the interdental brush package showed the brush size.
examples.zh: 我问「牙缝刷」包装上哪个图标表示刷子的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: a powered brush whose head moves to clean teeth

examples.en: I asked whether my electric toothbrush had a label showing the model number.
examples.zh: 我问我的「电动牙刷」上有没有标出型号的标签。

examples.en: My roommate packed her electric toothbrush in a separate case for the trip.
examples.zh: 我室友把她的「电动牙刷」装在单独的盒子里带去旅行。

words.enDefinition: a toothbrush made with softer flexible cleaning bristles

examples.en: The dentist's display showed a soft-bristled toothbrush next to several other types.
examples.zh: 牙医的展示区把「软毛牙刷」和好几种其他牙刷放在了一起。

examples.en: I asked which box on the shelf contained the soft-bristled toothbrush from the picture.
examples.zh: 我问架子上哪个盒子里装的是图片里的「软毛牙刷」。

words.enDefinition: the bristled end of a toothbrush that cleans the teeth

examples.en: I checked whether the toothbrush head would fit the handle I already owned.
examples.zh: 我确认了这个「牙刷刷头」装不装得上原来那支手柄。

examples.en: The shop assistant showed me where the toothbrush head size appeared on the packaging.
examples.zh: 店员指给我看包装上哪里标有「牙刷刷头」的尺寸。

words.enDefinition: a small handled tool with floss stretched across a fork

examples.en: The hygienist showed me a floss pick and explained its name in English.
examples.zh: 口腔卫生师给我看了一根「牙线棒」，还解释了对应的英语名称。

examples.en: I recognized the floss pick from the sample the dentist had on display.
examples.zh: 我从牙医摆着的样品中认出了「牙线棒」。

words.enDefinition: a device that directs a stream of water around teeth

examples.en: I asked what the different tips in the water flosser box were called.
examples.zh: 我问「冲牙器」盒里那些不同的喷头都叫什么。

examples.en: The shop displayed a water flosser beside several powered toothbrushes near the counter.
examples.zh: 商店把「冲牙器」摆在柜台附近，旁边是几款电动牙刷。

words.enDefinition: the way the upper and lower teeth fit together

examples.en: The orthodontist used a model to explain my bite alignment during the appointment.
examples.zh: 就诊时，正畸医生用模型给我说明了我的「咬合排列」。

examples.en: I asked whether the previous scan recorded my bite alignment clearly enough for comparison.
examples.zh: 我问之前的扫描有没有把我的「咬合排列」记录得够清楚，方便对比。

words.enDefinition: a misalignment of the upper and lower teeth when they meet

examples.en: The report used the word malocclusion, so I asked the dentist what it meant.
examples.zh: 报告用了「咬合不正」这个词，我就问牙医是什么意思。

examples.en: The orthodontist explained the notation for malocclusion on a diagram of my teeth.
examples.zh: 正畸医生在我的牙齿图上解释了「咬合不正」的标注。

words.enDefinition: the vertical overlap of the front upper and lower teeth

examples.en: I asked what the measurement beside overbite referred to on the printed chart.
examples.zh: 我问打印的记录图上，「覆牙合」旁边的测量值指什么。

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me how my overbite appeared in the profile photograph.
examples.zh: 正畸医生给我看了侧面照片上我的「覆牙合」是什么样子。

words.enDefinition: a bite with lower incisors ahead of upper incisors

examples.en: The dentist used two models to demonstrate what an underbite looks like.
examples.zh: 牙医用两个模型给我展示了「前牙反牙合」是什么样子。

examples.en: I asked which picture in the report illustrated the underbite we had discussed.
examples.zh: 我问报告里哪张图展示了我们谈到的「前牙反牙合」。

words.enDefinition: a bite in which some opposing teeth meet in a reversed inside-outside position

examples.en: The orthodontist pointed to the crossbite on the left side of the model.
examples.zh: 正畸医生指了指模型左侧的「交叉咬合」。

examples.en: I asked what kind of crossbite the dentist had recorded in my notes.
examples.zh: 我问牙医在我的记录里写的是哪种「交叉咬合」。

words.enDefinition: a gap where some upper and lower teeth do not meet

examples.en: The dentist demonstrated an open bite using a picture instead of the printed description.
examples.zh: 牙医用一张图片展示了「开牙合」，没有照着打印出来的描述讲。

examples.en: The orthodontist pointed to the space between teeth to illustrate the open bite.
examples.zh: 正畸医生指了指上下牙之间的空隙，说明「开牙合」。

words.enDefinition: a lack of space for teeth to line up normally

examples.en: The chart showed crowding in the lower teeth after I moved to a new clinic.
examples.zh: 我转到新诊所后，检查记录图上显示下排有「牙列拥挤」。

examples.en: I asked the orthodontist what the note about crowding meant in my case.
examples.zh: 我请正畸医生解释，对我来说关于「牙列拥挤」的备注是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a visible space between two adjacent teeth

examples.en: The dentist took a photograph of the tooth gap for my appointment record.
examples.zh: 牙医给「牙间隙」拍了张照片，作为这次就诊的记录。

examples.en: I asked whether the tooth gap we discussed appeared clearly in the new scan.
examples.zh: 我问刚谈到的「牙间隙」在新扫描里显示得清不清楚。

collocations: a tooth gap between the front teeth

words.enDefinition: orthodontic appliances commonly using brackets and wires to move teeth

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me two kinds of braces on the models in her office.
examples.zh: 正畸医生用诊室里的模型给我看了两种「牙齿矫治器」。

examples.en: I asked whether the clinic's written estimate for braces included later visits.
examples.zh: 我问诊所给「牙齿矫治器」的书面估价是否包含后续就诊。

words.enDefinition: fixed orthodontic appliances with brackets made of metal

examples.en: The clinic showed me a model with metal braces attached to the front teeth.
examples.zh: 诊所给我看了一个模型，前牙上装着「金属牙套」。

examples.en: I asked where metal braces were listed in the comparison sheet from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问诊所发的对照表把「金属牙套」列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: fixed orthodontic appliances with brackets made of ceramic

examples.en: I asked to see how ceramic braces looked on the display model.
examples.zh: 我想看看展示模型戴上「陶瓷牙套」是什么样子。

examples.en: The clinic listed ceramic braces separately from the standard metal option on its sheet.
examples.zh: 诊所在表上把「陶瓷牙套」和标准的金属牙套分开列了出来。

words.enDefinition: a clear removable tray designed to gradually move the teeth

examples.en: The orthodontist let me examine a clear aligner during the introductory consultation.
examples.zh: 初次咨询时，正畸医生让我仔细看了看一个「透明矫治器」。

examples.en: I asked which items in the estimate were related to the clear aligner.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上哪些项目和「透明矫治器」有关。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that holds teeth in their corrected positions

examples.en: I showed the receptionist the retainer named in my appointment reminder.
examples.zh: 我给前台看了预约提醒里提到的那个「正畸保持器」。

examples.en: The orthodontist asked me to bring my retainer and its case next time.
examples.zh: 正畸医生请我下次把「正畸保持器」和盒子一起带来。

words.enDefinition: a bonded orthodontic device holding teeth in position

examples.en: The orthodontist showed me where the fixed retainer sat behind the front teeth.
examples.zh: 正畸医生给我看了「固定式保持器」在前牙背面的哪个位置。

examples.en: The treatment summary listed a fixed retainer separately from the device I could remove.
examples.zh: 治疗摘要把「固定式保持器」和我能取下来的那个装置分开列。

words.enDefinition: a tooth-positioning appliance that the person can take out

examples.en: I asked what kind of case came with the removable retainer in the estimate.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上的「可摘式保持器」配的是什么样的盒子。

examples.en: The orthodontist took a picture of my removable retainer for the follow-up notes.
examples.zh: 正畸医生给我的「可摘式保持器」拍了张照，放进随访记录。

collocations: a case for a removable retainer

words.enDefinition: a planned change to how a corrective dental appliance fits

examples.en: My orthodontic adjustment was scheduled for the week after our final exams.
examples.zh: 我的「正畸调节」约在期末考试结束后一周。

examples.en: I asked how long the orthodontic adjustment appointment would take before changing my schedule.
examples.zh: 调整自己的日程前，我先问了「正畸调节」这次就诊会花多久。

collocations: an appointment for an orthodontic adjustment

words.enDefinition: a small attachment bonded to a tooth to hold a wire

examples.en: The orthodontist pointed to the orthodontic bracket on the model while describing the device.
examples.zh: 正畸医生介绍这个装置时，指了指模型上的「正畸托槽」。

examples.en: I called the clinic about the orthodontic bracket mentioned in my follow-up report.
examples.zh: 我给诊所打电话，询问随访报告里提到的那个「正畸托槽」。

words.enDefinition: a shaped wire that links brackets along a row of teeth

examples.en: The dentist pointed out the archwire in the picture from my orthodontic file.
examples.zh: 牙医在我的正畸档案照片上指出了那根「正畸弓丝」。

examples.en: I asked whether the archwire was included in the cost listed on the estimate.
examples.zh: 我问估价单上列的费用是否包含「正畸弓丝」。

words.enDefinition: small rubber loops used with certain orthodontic appliances

examples.en: The orthodontist explained why orthodontic elastics were mentioned on the written treatment plan.
examples.zh: 正畸医生解释了为什么书面治疗方案上提到了「正畸橡皮圈」。

examples.en: I asked where the leaflet identified the orthodontic elastics in the package diagram.
examples.zh: 我问说明书的包装示意图里，哪里标着「正畸橡皮圈」。

words.enDefinition: insurance benefits available for eligible dental services

examples.en: I asked the student benefits team where to check my dental coverage online.
examples.zh: 我问学生福利团队，在哪里可以网上查我的「牙科保险保障」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what the term dental coverage meant on our plan summary.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了保障摘要里的「牙科保险保障」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a request for insurance payment for a covered dental service

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether I wanted the office to submit the dental claim.
examples.zh: 前台问我是否要让诊所提交这笔「牙科理赔申请」。

examples.en: I called my insurer to check why the dental claim was still pending.
examples.zh: 我给保险公司打电话，问为什么那笔「牙科理赔申请」还在处理中。

words.enDefinition: a list of charges or payment rates for dental services

examples.en: I asked the clinic for its dental fee schedule before discussing the written estimate.
examples.zh: 在谈书面估价以前，我先向诊所要了它的「牙科收费价目表」。

examples.en: The student adviser showed me where the dental fee schedule was published on the website.
examples.zh: 学生顾问给我指出网站上哪里公布了「牙科收费价目表」。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of charges for planned dental services

examples.en: I brought the dental fee estimate to the campus benefits office for help reading it.
examples.zh: 我把「牙科费用估算单」带到学校福利办公室，请他们帮我看。

examples.en: The dental fee estimate showed separate amounts for the examination and taking images.
examples.zh: 「牙科费用估算单」分别列了检查和拍片的金额。

words.enDefinition: a bill listing charges for services provided by a dental office

examples.en: I asked the clinic for a dental invoice with the date of service shown.
examples.zh: 我请诊所开一份显示就诊日期的「牙科账单」。

examples.en: The dental invoice listed the examination separately from the new pictures of my teeth.
examples.zh: 「牙科账单」把检查和这次新拍的牙齿影像分开列了。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a dental service in a billing schedule

examples.en: The Australian clinic printed a dental item number beside each entry on the estimate.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的这家诊所在估价单每个项目旁都印了「牙科项目编号」。

examples.en: I asked which dental item number referred to the service we had just discussed.
examples.zh: 我问刚谈到的服务对应哪个「牙科项目编号」。

words.enDefinition: insurance benefits available for certain treatments that align teeth

examples.en: I asked the insurer where the plan explained orthodontic coverage for university students.
examples.zh: 我问保险公司，保险方案里哪里讲了大学生的「正畸保险保障」。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether orthodontic coverage was mentioned on the separate benefits page.
examples.zh: 顾问查了单独的保障页面上有没有提到「正畸保险保障」。

words.enDefinition: a calculation made before treatment of likely charges and benefits

examples.en: The dental office asked whether I wanted a pretreatment estimate sent to my insurer.
examples.zh: 牙科诊所问我，要不要把「治疗前费用预估」发给保险公司。

examples.en: I kept the pretreatment estimate with the other documents from the dental clinic.
examples.zh: 我把「治疗前费用预估」和牙科诊所给的其他文件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: the most a dental plan pays within one plan year

examples.en: I asked whether the dental plan annual maximum was a limit on insurance payments.
examples.zh: 我问「牙险年度赔付上限」是不是对保险赔付金额设的上限。

examples.en: The summary showed the dental plan annual maximum alongside the period it applied to.
examples.zh: 摘要列出了「牙险年度赔付上限」及其适用时段。

collocations: check a dental plan annual maximum
an increase in the dental plan annual maximum
services counting toward the dental plan annual maximum
